evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce LogiMed-RoB, a benchmark grounded in Cochrane Risk of Bias (RoB) 2.0 expert logic, comprising 860 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and 14,820 queries.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: LogiMed-RoB demonstrates that high outcome accuracy can conceal critical reasoning flaws, underscoring the necessity of white-box logical verification for clinical deployment.
